# Behaviour

Epic26D5Assignments consolidates three related Work Assignments records. Both the left route-detail and right work-request panels use one local scroll-reveal helper: idle scrollbars remain hidden, interaction reveals them for 950 milliseconds, and a stable gutter plus shared padding prevents the revealed scrollbar from changing content width.

Allocated requests are hidden from the map by default. The existing Operations Control footer exposes Show planned for cross-route reassignment; enabled planned markers use a muted colour and route badge, and the routed-request set spans route stops across all service dates.

# Evidence Boundary

Focused component tests, typecheck, lint, and build passed in the source records. Authenticated WorkOS browser UAT remained pending and no QA or production deployment was performed, so this concept does not claim hosted acceptance.
